decisions.choice: when Jesus had finished all these words: the formula that closes the last of the five long speeches
decisions.reason: Matthew ends each great speech this way (7:28; 11:1; 13:53; 19:1). Only here does he add "all", closing the speech of chapters 24-25 and perhaps the whole of Jesus's teaching before the passion.

decisions.choice: When Jesus had finished all these words
alternatives: When Jesus had finished saying all these things
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the wording of the same formula at 7:28.

decisions.choice: deity_pronoun spans only on separate pronouns and possessives (sus, le, me, mí, mi)
alternatives: a span on every pronoun the English marks
decisions.reason: Spanish leaves the subject pronoun out ("dijo"), and a pronoun joined to the end of a verb ("matarlo", "entregarlo") takes no span, so the setting covers fewer words than in English. The same through the passage.

decisions.choice: narration in the passé simple (L, B) and the passé composé (R); Matthew's historic presents kept as presents at Literal; speech keeps its own tenses at every level
decisions.reason: As in the rest of Matthew and in Mark 14: the passé simple is the normal tense of written narrative and suits a careful public reading; Readable uses the passé composé, as French is spoken and as young readers now meet stories. Literal keeps the present where Matthew tells a past event in the present (26:25, 26:31, 26:35). This holds for the whole chapter.

decisions.choice: Et il arriva, quand Jésus eut achevé toutes ces paroles (L); Quand Jésus eut achevé toutes ces paroles (B)
alternatives: Lorsque Jésus eut terminé tous ces discours
decisions.reason: The same formula closes each of Matthew's five speeches (m1); Literal and Balanced use the wording already set for it at 7:28, adding "toutes" as the Greek does here.

decisions.choice: deity_pronoun spans on free pronouns and possessives only (wanafunzi wake); none on verbs such as aliwaambia
decisions.reason: Swahili carries "he" and "him" in the verb, where a prefix cannot take a capital, so the setting covers only free pronouns and possessives, as in John. Swahili therefore has fewer spans than English through the passage.

decisions.choice: "khi Đức Giê-xu đã nói xong tất cả những lời này"
decisions.reason: The formula that closes each of Matthew's five long speeches (meaning decision), kept close to the wording used at the end of the earlier speeches so the pattern stays visible.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in Korean, through Matthew 26:1-16; "그분" (L), "예수" (B, R) in the narrative; "제자들" at every level
decisions.reason: Korean has no capital letters, so the setting has nothing to change (style guide, sections 4 and 7). "제자들" is the word at every level in the Korean Gospels, where the English Readable says "followers".

decisions.choice: "이 모든 말씀을 마치셨을 때에" (L, B)
decisions.reason: The formula that closes Jesus' long speeches (meaning decision); Korean keeps "말씀" so it reads alike at each of them (7:28; 11:1; 13:53; 19:1).

source.text: Οἴδατε ὅτι μετὰ δύο ἡμέρας τὸ πάσχα γίνεται, καὶ ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου παραδίδοται εἰς τὸ σταυρωθῆναι.

records.literal_gloss: You know that after two days the Passover takes place, and the Son of the Man is handed over for the to be crucified.

en.L: "You know that after two days the Passover comes, and the Son of Man is handed over to be crucified."
en.B: "As you know, the Passover is two days away, and the Son of Man will be handed over to be crucified."
en.R: "You know that the Passover festival is two days from now. At that time the Son of Man will be handed over to be killed on a cross."

es.L: «{{plural_you:Saben|Sabéis}} que después de dos días llega la Pascua, y el Hijo del Hombre es entregado para ser crucificado».
es.B: «Como {{plural_you:saben|sabéis}}, dentro de dos días es la Pascua, y el Hijo del Hombre va a ser entregado para ser crucificado».
es.R: «{{plural_you:Saben|Sabéis}} que la fiesta de la Pascua es dentro de dos días. Entonces el Hijo del Hombre será entregado para que muera en una cruz».

fr.L: « Vous savez que dans deux jours a lieu la Pâque, et le Fils de l’homme est livré pour être crucifié. »
fr.B: « Vous le savez, la Pâque aura lieu dans deux jours, et le Fils de l’homme sera livré pour être crucifié. »
fr.R: « Vous savez que la fête de la Pâque aura lieu dans deux jours. À ce moment-là, le Fils de l’homme sera livré pour être cloué sur une croix et mourir. »

sw.L: "Mnajua kwamba baada ya siku mbili Pasaka inakuja, na Mwana wa Adamu anatolewa ili asulubiwe."
sw.B: "Kama mnavyojua, zimebaki siku mbili tu kabla ya Pasaka, na Mwana wa Adamu atakabidhiwa ili asulubiwe."
sw.R: "Mnajua kwamba sikukuu ya Pasaka itakuwa baada ya siku mbili. Wakati huo Mwana wa Adamu atakabidhiwa ili auawe msalabani."

vi.L: "Các con biết rằng hai ngày nữa là Lễ Vượt Qua, và Con Người bị nộp để bị đóng đinh vào thập tự giá."
vi.B: "Các con biết đó, còn hai ngày nữa là đến Lễ Vượt Qua, và Con Người sẽ bị nộp để bị đóng đinh vào thập tự giá."
vi.R: "Các con biết rằng hai ngày nữa là đến Lễ Vượt Qua. Lúc ấy Con Người sẽ bị nộp cho người ta đóng đinh trên cây thập tự."

ko.L: "너희가 아는 대로, 이틀이 지나면 유월절이 되고, 인자는 십자가에 못 박히도록 넘겨진다."
ko.B: "너희도 알다시피, 이틀이 지나면 유월절이다. 그리고 인자는 넘겨져서 십자가에 못 박힐 것이다."
ko.R: "너희가 아는 대로, 이틀이 지나면 유월절 명절이다. 그때 인자는 넘겨져서 십자가에 못 박혀 죽을 것이다."

pt.L: "Vocês sabem que daqui a dois dias é a Páscoa, e o Filho do Homem é entregue para ser crucificado."
pt.B: "Como vocês sabem, faltam dois dias para a Páscoa, e o Filho do Homem será entregue para ser crucificado."
pt.R: "Vocês sabem que a festa da Páscoa vai ser daqui a dois dias. Nesse tempo, o Filho do Homem vai ser entregue para ser morto numa cruz."

decisions.choice: the Passover: the yearly feast remembering Israel's rescue from Egypt
decisions.reason: The Passover lamb was killed on the fourteenth of the month Nisan and eaten that night (Exodus 12:1-14). The seven days of Unleavened Bread followed, and pilgrims crowded into Jerusalem.

decisions.choice: is handed over: given up to his enemies, by Judas and in God's plan
decisions.reason: The verb means to hand over. It is used of Judas (10:4; 26:15) and in Jesus's earlier predictions of his death (17:22; 20:18-19).

decisions.choice: is handed over: the present tense for what is certain to happen soon
alternatives: is being handed over at this moment
decisions.reason: Jesus speaks of the coming event as already under way.

decisions.choice: will be handed over
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use the future, since the event is two days away.

decisions.choice: to be killed on a cross; at that time
decisions.reason: Readable explains crucifixion and links the two events, as the "and" of the Greek implies.

decisions.choice: entregado (every level here)
decisions.reason: The Greek verb is "hand over" (meaning decision m2): Judas gives Jesus up, and so does God's plan. "Entregar" says both. "Traicionar" is kept for the places where the English says "betray" (26:21-25, 26:46-48); Literal says "entregar" there too, so the repeated Greek word shows.

decisions.choice: la Pâque; livrer at every level (for the whole chapter)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's form: "la Pâque" is the Jewish feast, "Pâques" the Christian Easter. "Livrer" is the word of Jesus's sayings about being handed over (17:22, 20:18-19). French follows the English through the chapter: "livrer" where it says "hand over", including Judas's bargain (26:15-16), and "trahir" where Literal and Balanced say "betray" (26:21-25).

decisions.choice: anatolewa (L); atakabidhiwa (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Greek verb is "hand over" (meaning decision m2). "Kutoa" keeps the plain verb at Literal through the chapter; "kukabidhi" (to hand someone over to others) says it clearly at Balanced and Readable. "Kusaliti" (betray) is kept for the places where the English says "betray" (26:21-25, 26:46-48).

decisions.choice: "Lễ Vượt Qua"; "bị nộp"; "đóng đinh vào thập tự giá" (L, B), "đóng đinh trên cây thập tự" (R); Literal keeps the present "bị nộp" without "sẽ"
decisions.reason: The names and verbs of the parallels (Mark 14:1, 10; Matthew 20:19): "nộp" is the Gospels' word for handing over; the Greek present for what is certain to happen (meaning decision) stays unmarked at Literal.

decisions.choice: "넘겨진다" (L), "넘겨지다" (B, R) for paradidomi; "십자가에 못 박히다"
decisions.reason: The verb of 24:9-10 and of Judas in 26:15-16, so the thread stays visible; Literal keeps the Greek present for what is certain to happen (meaning decision). The Son of Man takes no honorific in Jesus' mouth.

source.text: Τότε συνήχθησαν οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι τοῦ λαοῦ εἰς τὴν αὐλὴν τοῦ ἀρχιερέως τοῦ λεγομένου Καϊάφα, καὶ συνεβουλεύσαντο ἵνα τὸν Ἰησοῦν δόλῳ κρατήσωσιν καὶ ἀποκτείνωσιν·

records.literal_gloss: Then were gathered the chief priests and the elders of the people in the courtyard of the high priest, the one called Caiaphas, \v 4 and they plotted together that the Jesus by deceit they might seize and kill;

en.L: Then the chief priests and the elders of the people were gathered in the courtyard of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas, \v 4 and they plotted together to seize Jesus by deceit and kill {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: Then the chief priests and the elders of the people met in the courtyard of the high priest, a man named Caiaphas. \v 4 There they made plans to arrest Jesus by some trick and put {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to death.
en.R: At that time the leading priests and the older leaders of the people met at the home of the high priest. His name was Caiaphas. \v 4 They made a plan to arrest Jesus secretly and kill {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

es.L: Entonces se reunieron los principales sacerdotes y los ancianos del pueblo en el patio del sumo sacerdote, el llamado Caifás, \v 4 y deliberaron juntos para apresar a Jesús con engaño y matarlo.
es.B: Entonces los jefes de los sacerdotes y los ancianos del pueblo se reunieron en el patio del sumo sacerdote, un hombre llamado Caifás. \v 4 Allí hicieron planes para arrestar a Jesús con alguna trampa y darle muerte.
es.R: En ese tiempo, los jefes de los sacerdotes y los ancianos que dirigían al pueblo se reunieron en la casa del sumo sacerdote. Se llamaba Caifás. \v 4 Hicieron un plan para arrestar a Jesús en secreto y matarlo.

fr.L: Alors les chefs des prêtres et les anciens du peuple se rassemblèrent dans la cour du grand prêtre, appelé Caïphe, \v 4 et ils se concertèrent pour s’emparer de Jésus par ruse et {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} tuer.
fr.B: Alors les chefs des prêtres et les anciens du peuple se réunirent dans la cour du grand prêtre, un homme nommé Caïphe. \v 4 Là, ils décidèrent ensemble d’arrêter Jésus par une ruse et de {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} faire mourir.
fr.R: À ce moment-là, les chefs des prêtres et les anciens qui dirigeaient le peuple se sont réunis dans la maison du grand prêtre. Il s’appelait Caïphe. \v 4 Ils ont fait un plan pour arrêter Jésus en secret et {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} tuer.

sw.L: Kisha wakakusanyika wakuu wa makuhani na wazee wa watu katika ua wa kuhani mkuu, yule aitwaye Kayafa, \v 4 wakapanga njama pamoja kwamba wamtie Yesu mbaroni kwa udanganyifu na kumuua.
sw.B: Kisha wakuu wa makuhani na wazee wa watu walikutana katika ua wa kuhani mkuu, mtu mmoja aitwaye Kayafa. \v 4 Huko walifanya mipango ya kumkamata Yesu kwa ujanja na kumuua.
sw.R: Wakati huo wakuu wa makuhani na wazee waliowaongoza watu walikutana nyumbani kwa kuhani mkuu. Jina lake lilikuwa Kayafa. \v 4 Walipanga kumkamata Yesu kwa siri na kumuua.

vi.L: Bấy giờ các thầy tế lễ cả và các trưởng lão của dân chúng nhóm họp tại dinh thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm tên là Cai-phe, \v 4 và họ bàn mưu với nhau để dùng mưu kế bắt Đức Giê-xu và giết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Bấy giờ các thầy tế lễ cả và các trưởng lão của dân chúng họp lại tại dinh thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm, là người tên Cai-phe. \v 4 Tại đó họ bàn mưu dùng thủ đoạn để bắt Đức Giê-xu và giết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Lúc ấy các thầy tế lễ cả và các trưởng lão, là những người lãnh đạo dân chúng, họp nhau tại nhà thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm. Ông này tên là Cai-phe. \v 4 Họ bàn kế hoạch để bí mật bắt Đức Giê-xu và giết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그때에 대제사장들과 백성의 장로들이 가야바라고 하는 대제사장의 뜰에 모였다. \v 4 그리고 그들은 속임수로 예수를 붙잡아 죽이려고 함께 의논하였다.
ko.B: 그때에 대제사장들과 백성의 장로들이 가야바라는 대제사장의 관저에 모였다. \v 4 그들은 꾀를 써서 예수를 붙잡아 죽이려고 모의하였다.
ko.R: 그때 대제사장들과 백성의 장로들이 대제사장의 집에 모였다. 그 대제사장의 이름은 가야바였다. \v 4 그들은 아무도 모르게 예수를 붙잡아 죽일 계획을 세웠다.

pt.L: Então os chefes dos sacerdotes e os anciãos do povo se reuniram no pátio do sumo sacerdote, que se chamava Caifás, \v 4 e deliberaram juntos para prender Jesus com astúcia e matá-{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}}.
pt.B: Então os chefes dos sacerdotes e os anciãos do povo se reuniram no pátio do sumo sacerdote, um homem chamado Caifás. \v 4 Ali eles fizeram planos para prender Jesus por meio de alguma artimanha e matá-{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}}.
pt.R: Nesse tempo, os chefes dos sacerdotes e os líderes mais velhos do povo se reuniram na casa do sumo sacerdote. O nome dele era Caifás. \v 4 Eles fizeram um plano para prender Jesus em segredo e matá-{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}}.

decisions.choice: Caiaphas: high priest from about AD 18 to 36
decisions.reason: Joseph Caiaphas held the office longer than any other high priest under Roman rule. John 18:13 says he was the son-in-law of Annas, an earlier high priest.

decisions.choice: courtyard: the open court of the high priest's residence, or the residence itself
decisions.reason: The word means an enclosed courtyard and can stand for the whole palace around it. The same place appears in 26:58 and 26:69.

decisions.choice: by deceit: by stealth, away from the crowds
decisions.reason: They want to take him quietly, by some trick, for fear of the people (26:5).

decisions.choice: leading priests; older leaders
decisions.reason: Readable says who these groups were, as in 2:4.

decisions.choice: los principales sacerdotes (L), los jefes de los sacerdotes (B, R); los ancianos del pueblo (L, B), los ancianos que dirigían al pueblo (R); el sumo sacerdote
decisions.reason: The terms used for these groups throughout Matthew, recorded once in this passage. Readable says what the elders were, as the English "older leaders" does. Literal keeps the traditional title for the chief priests, as Mark and John do; Balanced and Readable say plainly that they were the heads of the priesthood.

decisions.choice: les chefs des prêtres; les anciens (every level, with "qui dirigeaient le peuple" at R); le grand prêtre (no hyphen); Caïphe
decisions.reason: The term sheet's forms, as in Mark 14. English Readable says "leading priests" and "older leaders"; "les chefs des prêtres" is already plain, and Readable keeps "les anciens", the word used for them through the Passion, saying in a relative clause that they led the people. "Caïphe" is the usual French form of the name.

decisions.choice: wakuu wa makuhani; wazee wa watu (L, B), wazee waliowaongoza watu (R); kuhani mkuu
decisions.reason: The terms used for these groups throughout Matthew, recorded once in this passage. Readable says what the elders were, as the English "older leaders" does.

decisions.choice: "các thầy tế lễ cả"; "các trưởng lão" (R adds "là những người lãnh đạo dân chúng"); "dinh" (L, B), "nhà" (R); "thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm"; "Cai-phe"
decisions.reason: The settled Protestant terms and the forms of 21:23 and Mark 14; the Greek word is the court or the residence itself (meaning decision), and "dinh" names a high official's residence with its court.

decisions.choice: "대제사장들", "장로들" at every level
decisions.reason: The words of the Korean Mark 14 and Matthew 16:21; both are plain enough for Readable.
The word means the open court or the residence itself (meaning decision); Literal keeps the court, Balanced and Readable name the house.

decisions.choice: os chefes dos sacerdotes; os líderes mais velhos do povo
decisions.reason: "Os chefes dos sacerdotes" already says who they were, so Readable keeps the settled term (style §6); for the elders it follows the English, since "anciãos" is a word young readers may not know.

source.text: ἔλεγον δέ· Μὴ ἐν τῇ ἑορτῇ, ἵνα μὴ θόρυβος γένηται ἐν τῷ λαῷ.

records.literal_gloss: They were saying but, Not at the feast, so that not an uproar happens among the people.

en.L: But they were saying, "Not during the feast, so that there may not be an uproar among the people."
en.B: But they kept saying, "Not at the festival. We do not want the people to riot."
en.R: But they said, "We must not do it during the festival. The people might start a riot."

es.L: Pero decían: «No durante la fiesta, para que no haya un alboroto en el pueblo».
es.B: Pero insistían: «No en la fiesta, para que no se amotine el pueblo».
es.R: Pero decían: «No debemos hacerlo durante la fiesta. La gente podría armar un alboroto».

fr.L: Mais ils disaient : « Pas pendant la fête, afin qu’il n’y ait pas de tumulte parmi le peuple. »
fr.B: Mais ils répétaient : « Pas pendant la fête. Il ne faut pas que le peuple se soulève. »
fr.R: Mais ils disaient : « Il ne faut pas le faire pendant la fête. Le peuple pourrait se révolter. »

sw.L: Lakini walikuwa wakisema, "Si katika sikukuu, ili pasiwe na fujo miongoni mwa watu."
sw.B: Lakini waliendelea kusema, "Tusifanye hivyo wakati wa sikukuu, watu wasije wakaanzisha fujo."
sw.R: Lakini walisema, "Tusifanye hivyo wakati wa sikukuu. Watu wanaweza kufanya fujo."

vi.L: Nhưng họ nói: "Đừng [làm] trong kỳ lễ, kẻo có náo loạn trong dân chúng."
vi.B: Nhưng họ cứ bảo nhau: "Đừng làm trong kỳ lễ, kẻo dân chúng gây náo loạn."
vi.R: Nhưng họ nói: "Chúng ta không được làm việc này trong kỳ lễ. Dân chúng có thể nổi loạn."

ko.L: 그러나 그들은 "명절에는 안 된다. 백성 가운데 소동이 일어나지 않도록 해야 한다" 하고 말하고 있었다.
ko.B: 그러나 그들은 "명절에는 안 된다. 백성이 소동을 일으킬지도 모른다" 하고 말했다.
ko.R: 그러나 그들은 "명절에는 그렇게 하지 말자. 사람들이 폭동을 일으킬지도 모른다" 하고 말했다.

pt.L: Mas diziam: "Não durante a festa, para que não haja tumulto entre o povo."
pt.B: Mas eles diziam: "Não durante a festa. Não queremos que o povo se revolte."
pt.R: Mas eles disseram: "Não podemos fazer isso durante a festa. O povo pode começar uma revolta."

decisions.choice: an uproar among the people: the crowds of pilgrims, many of whom welcomed Jesus
decisions.reason: Jerusalem was crowded at Passover, and the crowds had hailed Jesus (21:8-11). The leaders had already held back for fear of them (21:46).

decisions.choice: not during the feast: not in the festival days
decisions.reason: The phrase may mean the days of the feast or the crowd gathered for it. Either way they want to avoid a public arrest; in the end Judas's offer lets them act at once.

decisions.choice: We do not want (B); The people might (R)
alternatives: so that there may not be
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable turn the purpose clause into a plain statement of the leaders' fear.

decisions.choice: Worded as the Korean Mark 14:2
decisions.reason: The two Gospels say the same thing in nearly the same Greek; Korean keeps them alike.

source.text: Τοῦ δὲ Ἰησοῦ γενομένου ἐν Βηθανίᾳ ἐν οἰκίᾳ Σίμωνος τοῦ λεπροῦ, προσῆλθεν αὐτῷ γυνὴ ἔχουσα ἀλάβαστρον μύρου βαρυτίμου καὶ κατέχεεν ἐπὶ τῆς κεφαλῆς αὐτοῦ ἀνακειμένου.

records.literal_gloss: The but Jesus being in Bethany in house of Simon the leper, \v 7 came to him a woman having an alabaster flask of ointment very costly and poured [it] on the head of him reclining.

en.L: Now while Jesus was in Bethany, in [the] house of Simon the leper, \v 7 a woman came to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} having an alabaster jar of very costly ointment, and she poured [it] on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} head as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was reclining [at table].
en.B: While Jesus was at Bethany in the home of Simon, a man who had suffered from a skin disease, \v 7 a woman came up to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} with an alabaster jar of very expensive perfumed oil. As {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} sat at the table, she poured it over {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} head.
en.R: Jesus was in the town of Bethany. He was at the house of a man named Simon, who had once had a bad skin disease. \v 7 While Jesus was eating there, a woman came to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. She had a beautiful stone jar full of perfume that cost a great deal of money. She poured the perfume on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} head.

es.L: Y estando Jesús en Betania, en casa de Simón el leproso, \v 7 se {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} acercó una mujer que tenía un frasco de alabastro con perfume muy caro, y [lo] derramó sobre {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} cabeza mientras {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} estaba recostado [a la mesa].
es.B: Mientras Jesús estaba en Betania, en casa de Simón, un hombre que había padecido una enfermedad de la piel, \v 7 se {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} acercó una mujer con un frasco de alabastro lleno de un perfume muy caro. Mientras {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} estaba sentado a la mesa, ella derramó el perfume sobre {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} cabeza.
es.R: Jesús estaba en el pueblo de Betania. Estaba en la casa de un hombre llamado Simón, que antes había tenido una enfermedad grave de la piel. \v 7 Mientras Jesús comía allí, una mujer se {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} acercó. Traía un hermoso frasco de piedra lleno de un perfume que costaba muchísimo dinero. Derramó el perfume sobre {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} cabeza.

fr.L: Or comme Jésus était à Béthanie, dans la maison de Simon le lépreux, \v 7 une femme s’approcha de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, ayant un flacon d’albâtre [rempli] d’un parfum très coûteux, et elle [le] versa sur {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} tête, tandis qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} était étendu [à table].
fr.B: Pendant que Jésus était à Béthanie, chez Simon, un homme qui avait souffert d’une maladie de peau, \v 7 une femme s’approcha de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} avec un flacon d’albâtre plein d’un parfum de grand prix. Alors qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} était à table, elle le répandit sur {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} tête.
fr.R: Jésus était dans le village de Béthanie. Il était dans la maison d’un homme appelé Simon. Autrefois, Simon avait eu une grave maladie de peau. \v 7 Pendant que Jésus mangeait là, une femme est venue près de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Elle avait un beau pot en pierre plein d’un parfum qui coûtait très cher. Elle a versé ce parfum sur {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} tête.

sw.L: Na Yesu alipokuwa Bethania, katika nyumba ya Simoni yule mwenye ukoma, \v 7 mwanamke mmoja alimwendea, akiwa na chupa ya alabasta yenye mafuta ya manukato ya bei ghali sana, akayamwaga juu ya kichwa {{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}} alipokuwa ameegemea [mezani].
sw.B: Yesu alipokuwa Bethania nyumbani kwa Simoni, mtu aliyewahi kuugua ugonjwa wa ngozi, \v 7 mwanamke mmoja alimjia akiwa na chupa ya alabasta yenye mafuta ya manukato ya bei ghali mno. Alipokuwa ameketi mezani, mwanamke huyo akayamimina mafuta hayo juu ya kichwa {{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}}.
sw.R: Yesu alikuwa katika mji wa Bethania. Alikuwa nyumbani kwa mtu mmoja aitwaye Simoni, ambaye zamani alikuwa na ugonjwa mbaya wa ngozi. \v 7 Yesu alipokuwa akila chakula huko, mwanamke mmoja alimjia. Alikuwa na chupa nzuri ya jiwe iliyojaa manukato ya bei kubwa sana. Akayamimina manukato hayo juu ya kichwa {{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}}.

vi.L: Khi Đức Giê-xu đang ở Bê-tha-ni, trong nhà Si-môn người phung, \v 7 có một người phụ nữ đến với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, mang theo một bình thạch cao đựng dầu thơm rất đắt giá, và đổ [dầu] trên đầu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đang ngả mình [bên bàn ăn].
vi.B: Khi Đức Giê-xu đang ở Bê-tha-ni, tại nhà Si-môn, người từng bị phung, \v 7 có một người phụ nữ đến gần {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, mang theo một bình thạch cao đựng dầu thơm rất quý giá. Trong lúc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đang ngồi dùng bữa, cô đổ dầu trên đầu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu đang ở làng Bê-tha-ni. Ngài ở tại nhà một người tên là Si-môn. Ông này trước kia từng mắc một bệnh ngoài da nặng. \v 7 Trong lúc Đức Giê-xu đang ăn ở đó, có một người phụ nữ đến gần {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Cô mang theo một cái bình làm bằng đá trắng quý, đựng đầy dầu thơm rất đắt tiền. Cô đổ dầu thơm lên đầu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그런데 예수께서 베다니에서 나병 환자 시몬의 집에 계실 때에, \v 7 한 여자가 매우 값진 향유가 든 설화석고 병을 가지고 그분께 다가와, [식탁에] 기대어 앉아 계신 그분의 머리에 [그것을] 부었다.
ko.B: 예수께서 베다니에 있는 나병 환자 시몬의 집에 계실 때에, \v 7 한 여자가 매우 값진 향유가 든 설화석고 병을 가지고 예수께 다가왔다. 그리고 식탁에 앉아 계신 예수의 머리에 향유를 부었다.
ko.R: 예수께서 베다니라는 마을에 계셨다. 예수께서는 시몬이라는 사람의 집에 계셨는데, 시몬은 전에 심한 피부병을 앓던 사람이었다. \v 7 예수께서 그 집에서 식사를 하고 계실 때, 한 여자가 예수께 다가왔다. 그 여자는 하얀 돌로 만든 아름다운 병을 들고 있었다. 병에는 아주 비싼 향유가 가득 들어 있었다. 그 여자는 그 향유를 예수의 머리에 부었다.

pt.L: E, estando Jesus em Betânia, na casa de Simão, o leproso, \v 7 veio a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} uma mulher que tinha um frasco de alabastro de unguento muito caro, e o derramou sobre a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} cabeça, estando {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} reclinado [à mesa].
pt.B: Enquanto Jesus estava em Betânia, na casa de Simão, um homem que tinha sofrido de uma doença de pele, \v 7 aproximou-se {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} uma mulher com um frasco de alabastro cheio de um óleo perfumado muito caro. Enquanto {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} estava à mesa, ela derramou o perfume sobre a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} cabeça.
pt.R: Jesus estava na cidade de Betânia. Ele estava na casa de um homem chamado Simão, que antes tinha tido uma doença de pele grave. \v 7 Enquanto Jesus comia ali, uma mulher chegou perto {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}. Ela tinha um lindo vaso de pedra cheio de um perfume que custava muito dinheiro. Ela derramou o perfume na cabeça {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}.

decisions.choice: Simon the leper: known by a skin disease he had once had, probably healed
alternatives: a man still unclean with the disease
decisions.reason: A man still unclean could not have received guests at his table (Leviticus 13:45-46). The name may recall a past illness, perhaps one Jesus healed (8:2-3).

decisions.choice: an alabaster jar of very costly ointment: a sealed stone jar of perfumed oil
decisions.reason: Alabaster was a soft, translucent stone used for jars of perfume. Mark 14:3 says she broke the jar to pour it; Mark 14:5 values it at more than three hundred denarii, about a year's wages.

decisions.choice: poured it on his head: an act of honor, recalling the anointing of kings
decisions.reason: Oil was poured on a guest's head as an honor (Psalm 23:5), and kings were anointed on the head (1 Samuel 10:1). Jesus himself gives the act its meaning in 26:12.

decisions.choice: a man who had suffered from a skin disease (B); who had once had a bad skin disease (R)
decisions.reason: As in 8:2, Balanced and Readable describe the disease. Saying it was in the past follows meaning decision m1 and is not certain.

decisions.choice: un flacon d’albâtre (L, B), un beau pot en pierre (R); parfum (every level)
decisions.reason: As in Mark 14:3: "parfum" is the usual French word for such a costly scented oil (m2) and reads naturally in 26:9 and 26:12; "onguent" now sounds medical. Readable describes the stone jar, as the English does.

decisions.choice: Simoni yule mwenye ukoma
decisions.reason: "Mwenye ukoma" (who has leprosy) describes the man; "mkoma" makes the disease his name. Balanced and Readable say he had suffered from a skin disease, as the English does (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: "người phung" (L), "người từng bị phung" (B), described (R); "bình thạch cao"; "dầu thơm"; "ngả mình [bên bàn ăn]" (L), "ngồi dùng bữa" (B), "ăn" (R)
decisions.reason: The wording of the parallel, Mark 14:3. Simon had once had the disease and was probably healed (meaning decision), which Balanced says with "từng".

decisions.choice: "설화석고 병" (L, B); "하얀 돌로 만든 병" (R)
decisions.reason: As in the Korean Mark 14:3: "옥합" is the familiar older word but means a jade box; the jar was of alabaster, a soft white stone.

decisions.choice: "나병 환자" (L, B); "전에 심한 피부병을 앓던" (R)
decisions.reason: As in the Korean Mark 14:3 and Matthew 8:2: "문둥이" is offensive today; Readable says what the English Readable says.

decisions.choice: [식탁에] 기대어 앉아; [그것을] (L)
decisions.reason: Guests reclined at table (meaning decision); Korean needs the table and an object for "poured", which Literal brackets, as in the Korean Matthew 22:10.

decisions.choice: unguento (L); óleo perfumado (B); perfume (R)
decisions.reason: The word names a perfumed oil. Literal keeps "unguento", the old exact word; Balanced says what it was, "óleo perfumado", since a Brazilian "perfume" is usually alcohol-based; Readable says "perfume", as the English does.

source.text: ἰδόντες δὲ οἱ μαθηταὶ ἠγανάκτησαν λέγοντες· Εἰς τί ἡ ἀπώλεια αὕτη;

records.literal_gloss: Having seen but the disciples were indignant saying, For what the waste this?

en.L: But when the disciples saw [it], they were indignant, saying, "Why this waste?
en.B: Seeing this, the disciples were indignant. They said, "What is the point of such waste?
en.R: When the followers saw this, they were upset. They said, "Why waste all that perfume?

es.L: Pero al ver[lo], los discípulos se indignaron, diciendo: «¿Para qué este desperdicio?
es.B: Al ver esto, los discípulos se indignaron y dijeron: «¿A qué viene semejante derroche?
es.R: Cuando los seguidores vieron esto, se enojaron. Dijeron: «¿Por qué desperdiciar todo ese perfume?

fr.L: Mais voyant [cela], les disciples s’indignèrent, disant : « Pourquoi ce gaspillage ?
fr.B: En voyant cela, les disciples s’indignèrent. Ils dirent : « À quoi bon un tel gaspillage ?
fr.R: Quand les disciples ont vu cela, ils se sont fâchés. Ils ont dit : « Pourquoi gaspiller tout ce parfum ?

sw.L: Lakini wanafunzi walipoona [hayo], walikasirika, wakisema, "Hasara hii ni ya nini?
sw.B: Wanafunzi walipoona hayo, walikasirika, wakasema, "Kwa nini kupoteza kitu cha thamani namna hii?
sw.R: Wanafunzi walipoona hayo, walichukia. Wakasema, "Kwa nini kumwaga manukato yote hayo bure?

vi.L: Nhưng khi thấy [vậy], các môn đồ tức giận nói: "Sao lại phí phạm như thế này?
vi.B: Thấy vậy, các môn đồ bất bình nói: "Phí của như vậy để làm gì?
vi.R: Khi các môn đồ thấy điều đó, họ bực tức. Họ nói: "Sao lại phí dầu thơm như vậy?

ko.L: 그러나 제자들이 [그것을] 보고 화를 내며 말했다. "무엇 때문에 이렇게 허비하느냐?
ko.B: 제자들이 이것을 보고 분개하여 말했다. "왜 이렇게 낭비하느냐?
ko.R: 제자들이 이것을 보고 화가 났다. 그들이 말했다. "왜 저 비싼 향유를 저렇게 낭비하느냐?

pt.L: Mas, vendo [isso], os discípulos ficaram indignados, dizendo: "Para que este desperdício?
pt.B: Ao verem isso, os discípulos ficaram indignados e disseram: "Para que tanto desperdício?
pt.R: Quando os seguidores de Jesus viram isso, ficaram irritados. Eles disseram: "Por que desperdiçar todo esse perfume?

decisions.choice: the disciples: Matthew speaks of the group
decisions.reason: John 12:4-6 names Judas as the one who complained. Matthew says the disciples as a whole objected.

decisions.choice: waste: loss, something thrown away
decisions.reason: The word means ruin or loss; here money poured out for nothing, as they see it.

decisions.choice: "các môn đồ" at every level
decisions.reason: "Môn đồ" is the style guide's word for disciples at every level, Readable included, where the English Readable says "followers".

decisions.choice: [그것을] (L)
decisions.reason: Korean needs an object for "saw"; Literal brackets it. The disciples speak among themselves in 해라체, as the bystanders do in the Korean Mark 14:4.

source.text: ἐδύνατο γὰρ τοῦτο πραθῆναι πολλοῦ καὶ δοθῆναι πτωχοῖς.

records.literal_gloss: Could for this to be sold for much and to be given to poor.

en.L: For this could have been sold for much and given to [the] poor."
en.B: It could have been sold for a large sum and the money given to the poor."
en.R: It could have been sold for a lot of money. Then the money could have been given to poor people."

es.L: Porque esto podía haberse vendido por mucho y haberse dado a [los] pobres».
es.B: Se podría haber vendido por una gran suma y haber dado el dinero a los pobres».
es.R: Se podría haber vendido por mucho dinero. Y ese dinero se les podría haber dado a los pobres».

fr.L: Car ce [parfum] aurait pu être vendu cher et [l’argent] être donné à des pauvres. »
fr.B: On aurait pu le vendre très cher et donner l’argent aux pauvres. »
fr.R: On aurait pu le vendre pour beaucoup d’argent. Puis on aurait pu donner cet argent aux pauvres. »

sw.L: Kwa maana hii ingeweza kuuzwa kwa [bei] kubwa na kupewa maskini."
sw.B: Yangeweza kuuzwa kwa fedha nyingi, na fedha hizo wakapewa maskini."
sw.R: Yangeweza kuuzwa kwa fedha nyingi sana. Kisha fedha hizo zingeweza kugawiwa maskini."

vi.L: Vì dầu này có thể bán được nhiều tiền và đem cho người nghèo."
vi.B: Dầu này có thể bán được nhiều tiền và đem tiền ấy giúp người nghèo."
vi.R: Dầu ấy có thể bán được rất nhiều tiền. Rồi lấy tiền đó giúp người nghèo."

ko.L: 이것은 많은 값에 팔려서 가난한 사람들에게 주어질 수 있었다."
ko.B: 이것을 비싼 값에 팔아서 그 돈을 가난한 사람들에게 줄 수 있었을 것이다."
ko.R: 이 향유를 팔면 많은 돈을 받을 수 있었다. 그러면 그 돈을 가난한 사람들에게 줄 수 있었을 것이다."

pt.L: Pois isto poderia ter sido vendido por muito [dinheiro] e dado aos pobres."
pt.B: Isso poderia ter sido vendido por um bom dinheiro, e o dinheiro dado aos pobres."
pt.R: Ele podia ter sido vendido por muito dinheiro. Depois, o dinheiro podia ter sido dado às pessoas pobres."

decisions.choice: given to the poor: gifts to the poor were expected, especially at Passover
alternatives: a new idea of the disciples
decisions.reason: Giving to the poor was a duty of the law (Deuteronomy 15:11) and was linked with the feast (John 13:29).

decisions.choice: the money
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say that the money, not the perfume, would be given.

decisions.choice: ce [parfum] … [l’argent] être donné (L)
alternatives: cela aurait pu être vendu … et donné
decisions.reason: French "cela aurait pu être vendu" would leave the thing unnamed, and "et donné" would say the perfume was given away. Literal names both in brackets, as Balanced and Readable say "l’argent" with the English.

source.text: γνοὺς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Τί κόπους παρέχετε τῇ γυναικί;

records.literal_gloss: Having known but the Jesus said to them, Why troubles you cause to the woman?

en.L: But Jesus, knowing [this], said to them, "Why do you cause the woman trouble?
en.B: Jesus was aware of this and said to them, "Why make trouble for this woman?
en.R: Jesus knew what they were saying. So {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to them, "Why are you upsetting this woman?

es.L: Pero Jesús, conociendo [esto], les dijo: «¿Por qué {{plural_you:causan|causáis}} molestias a la mujer?
es.B: Jesús se dio cuenta y les dijo: «¿Por qué {{plural_you:molestan|molestáis}} a esta mujer?
es.R: Jesús sabía lo que estaban diciendo. Por eso les dijo: «¿Por qué {{plural_you:hacen|hacéis}} sentir mal a esta mujer?

fr.L: Mais Jésus, le sachant, leur dit : « Pourquoi causez-vous des ennuis à [cette] femme ?
fr.B: Jésus s’en aperçut et leur dit : « Pourquoi tourmentez-vous cette femme ?
fr.R: Jésus savait ce qu’ils disaient. Alors {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur a dit : « Pourquoi faites-vous de la peine à cette femme ?

sw.L: Lakini Yesu, akijua [hayo], akawaambia, "Kwa nini mnampa mwanamke taabu?
sw.B: Yesu alitambua hayo, akawaambia, "Mbona mnamsumbua mwanamke huyu?
sw.R: Yesu alijua walichokuwa wakisema. Basi akawaambia, "Kwa nini mnamhuzunisha mwanamke huyu?

vi.L: Nhưng Đức Giê-xu biết [điều đó], nói với họ: "Sao các con làm khó người phụ nữ?
vi.B: Đức Giê-xu biết vậy nên nói với họ: "Sao các con làm phiền người phụ nữ này?
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu biết họ đang nói gì. Vì thế {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với họ: "Sao các con lại làm phiền người phụ nữ này?

ko.L: 그러나 예수께서 [그것을] 아시고 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "어찌하여 그 여자를 괴롭히느냐?
ko.B: 예수께서 이것을 아시고 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "왜 이 여자를 괴롭히느냐?
ko.R: 예수께서 제자들이 하는 말을 아셨다. 그래서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "왜 이 여자를 못살게 구느냐?

pt.L: Mas Jesus, sabendo [disso], lhes disse: "Por que vocês incomodam a mulher?
pt.B: Jesus percebeu isso e lhes disse: "Por que vocês estão aborrecendo esta mulher?
pt.R: Jesus sabia o que eles estavam dizendo. Por isso {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes disse: "Por que vocês estão chateando esta mulher?

decisions.choice: knowing this: Jesus became aware of their complaint
decisions.reason: Matthew does not say how he knew; they may have spoken openly.

decisions.choice: cause trouble: bother, distress
decisions.reason: The phrase means to give someone grief or annoyance, here by criticizing her.

decisions.choice: {{plural_you:causan|causáis}} and the other plural "you" forms
decisions.reason: Jesus speaks to the disciples, so every plural "you", pronoun or verb, is the reader setting: ustedes (Latin America, the default) or vosotros (Spain). The same through the passage.

decisions.choice: "các con" for the disciples
decisions.reason: Matthew names the disciples (26:8), so Jesus speaks to them as "các con", as in Mark 14:6.

decisions.choice: [그것을] (L)
decisions.reason: Korean needs an object for "knowing"; Literal brackets it.

source.text: ἔργον γὰρ καλὸν ἠργάσατο εἰς ἐμέ·

records.literal_gloss: A work for good she worked for me;

en.L: For she has done a beautiful work for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.
en.B: What she has done for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} is a beautiful thing.
en.R: She has done a good and lovely thing for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.

es.L: Porque ha hecho una obra hermosa para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}.
es.B: Lo que ha hecho por {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} es algo hermoso.
es.R: Ha hecho algo bueno y bonito por {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}.

fr.L: Car elle a accompli une belle œuvre envers {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}.
fr.B: C’est une belle action qu’elle a faite pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}.
fr.R: Ce qu’elle a fait pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} est bon et beau.

vi.L: Vì cô ấy đã làm một việc tốt đẹp cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.B: Việc cô ấy làm cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là một việc tốt đẹp.
vi.R: Cô ấy đã làm một việc tốt đẹp cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.

ko.L: 그 여자는 나에게 좋은 일을 하였기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그 여자는 나에게 아름다운 일을 하였다.
ko.R: 이 여자는 나에게 좋고 아름다운 일을 하였다.

pt.L: Pois ela fez uma obra bela para {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}.
pt.B: O que ela fez por {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} foi uma coisa bonita.
pt.R: Ela fez uma coisa boa e bonita por {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}.

decisions.choice: beautiful: good and fitting
alternatives: good only in the moral sense
decisions.reason: The word joins what is good with what is fine and fitting. Her act was right for the moment.

decisions.choice: good and lovely
decisions.reason: Readable gives both sides of the word.

decisions.choice: "좋은" (L); "아름다운" (B); "좋고 아름다운" (R) for kalos
decisions.reason: The Greek word is good and fitting (meaning decision); the levels follow the Korean Mark 14:6, with Readable saying both, as the English Readable does.

source.text: πάντοτε γὰρ τοὺς πτωχοὺς ἔχετε μεθ’ ἑαυτῶν, ἐμὲ δὲ οὐ πάντοτε ἔχετε·

records.literal_gloss: Always for the poor you have with yourselves, me but not always you have;

en.L: For you always have the poor with you, but you do not always have {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.
en.B: The poor will always be among you, but I will not always be with you.
en.R: There will always be poor people among you. But I will not always be here with you.

es.L: Porque a los pobres siempre los {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, pero a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} no siempre {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}}.
es.B: A los pobres siempre los {{plural_you:tendrán|tendréis}} entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, pero yo no siempre estaré con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.R: Siempre habrá gente pobre entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Pero yo no voy a estar siempre aquí con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.

fr.L: Car les pauvres, vous [les] avez toujours avec vous, mais {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, vous ne {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}avez pas toujours.
fr.B: Les pauvres seront toujours parmi vous, mais {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, je ne serai pas toujours avec vous.
fr.R: Il y aura toujours des pauvres près de vous. Mais je ne serai pas toujours là avec vous.

sw.L: Maana maskini mko nao kila wakati, lakini {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} hamko nami kila wakati.
sw.B: Maskini watakuwa pamoja nanyi siku zote, lakini {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} sitakuwa nanyi siku zote.
sw.R: Siku zote kutakuwa na watu maskini kati yenu. Lakini {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} sitakuwa hapa pamoja nanyi siku zote.

vi.L: Vì người nghèo thì các con luôn có ở với mình, nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} thì các con không có luôn luôn.
vi.B: Người nghèo thì luôn ở giữa các con, nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không ở với các con mãi đâu.
vi.R: Lúc nào cũng có người nghèo ở giữa các con. Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không ở đây với các con mãi.

ko.L: 가난한 사람들은 늘 너희와 함께 있지만, 나는 늘 너희와 함께 있지 않기 때문이다.
ko.B: 가난한 사람들은 언제나 너희 곁에 있겠지만, 나는 언제까지나 너희 곁에 있지는 않을 것이다.
ko.R: 가난한 사람들은 언제나 너희 가까이에 있을 것이다. 그러나 나는 언제까지나 여기 너희와 함께 있지는 않을 것이다.

pt.L: Pois sempre vocês têm os pobres com vocês, mas a {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} nem sempre [me] têm.
pt.B: Os pobres sempre estarão no meio de vocês, mas eu não estarei sempre com vocês.
pt.R: Sempre vai haver pessoas pobres no meio de vocês. Mas eu não vou estar sempre aqui com vocês.

decisions.choice: you always have the poor with you: Deuteronomy 15:11
decisions.reason: The law says the poor will never cease from the land, and so God's people must open their hand to them. Jesus does not set aside that duty.

decisions.choice: not always have me: Jesus points to his coming death
alternatives: he is leaving on a journey
decisions.reason: The time with him is short (26:2, 12), so honoring him now is fitting.

decisions.choice: I will not always be with you
alternatives: you do not always have me
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make Jesus the subject, which is more natural English.

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}
decisions.reason: The English Balanced and Readable say "I", which takes no span. Swahili keeps the stressed free pronoun "mimi" that the Greek has, and it takes the setting when Jesus speaks of himself, as the Swahili style guide sets out.

decisions.choice: "가난한 사람들은 늘 너희와 함께 있지만" (L)
alternatives: "너희는 가난한 사람들을 늘 너희와 함께 가지고 있다"
decisions.reason: As in the Korean Mark 14:7: Korean does not "have" people with it, so Literal makes the poor the subject and keeps the contrast with "나는".

source.text: βαλοῦσα γὰρ αὕτη τὸ μύρον τοῦτο ἐπὶ τοῦ σώματός μου πρὸς τὸ ἐνταφιάσαι με ἐποίησεν.

records.literal_gloss: Having poured for this [woman] the ointment this on the body of me, for the to prepare for burial me she did [it].

en.L: For in pouring this ointment on {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} body, she did [it] to prepare {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} for burial.
en.B: By pouring this perfume over {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} body, she has made {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} ready to be buried.
en.R: She put this perfume on {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} body to get {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} ready to be buried.

es.L: Porque al derramar ella este perfume sobre {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} cuerpo, lo hizo para prepararme para la sepultura.
es.B: Al derramar este perfume sobre {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} cuerpo, {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} ha preparado para ser sepultado.
es.R: Ella puso este perfume sobre {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} cuerpo para prepararme para el entierro.

fr.L: Car en versant ce parfum sur {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} corps, elle l’a fait pour {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} préparer à la sépulture.
fr.B: En répandant ce parfum sur {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} corps, elle {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}a préparé à être enseveli.
fr.R: Elle a mis ce parfum sur {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} corps pour {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} préparer à être enterré.

sw.L: Kwa maana huyu, kwa kuyamimina manukato haya juu ya mwili {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, amefanya hivyo ili kuniandaa kwa maziko.
sw.B: Kwa kumimina manukato haya juu ya mwili {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, amenitayarisha kwa ajili ya kuzikwa.
sw.R: Ameyapaka manukato haya mwilini {{deity_pronoun:mwangu|Mwangu}} ili kunitayarisha kwa mazishi.

vi.L: Vì khi đổ dầu thơm này trên thân thể {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, cô ấy đã làm [điều đó] để chuẩn bị tẩm liệm {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.B: Khi đổ dầu thơm này lên thân thể {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, cô ấy đã chuẩn bị {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cho việc tẩm liệm.
vi.R: Cô ấy đổ dầu thơm này lên thân thể {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} để chuẩn bị cho việc chôn cất {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.

ko.L: 이 여자가 이 향유를 내 몸에 부은 것은 나를 장사 지내려고 한 것이다.
ko.B: 이 여자가 내 몸에 이 향유를 부은 것은 내 장례를 준비한 것이다.
ko.R: 이 여자는 내가 묻힐 때를 위하여 내 몸에 이 향유를 부어 준비해 준 것이다.

pt.L: Pois, derramando este unguento sobre o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} corpo, ela [o] fez para {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} preparar para o sepultamento.
pt.B: Ao derramar este perfume sobre o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} corpo, ela {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} preparou para ser sepultado.
pt.R: Ela pôs este perfume no {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} corpo para {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} deixar pronto para ser enterrado.

decisions.choice: to prepare me for burial: bodies were anointed with oil and spices for burial
decisions.reason: Jews anointed the dead before burial (Mark 16:1; John 19:39-40). Jesus says this anointing comes before his death.

decisions.choice: she did it for my burial: Jesus gives the act its meaning
alternatives: she knew he was about to die
decisions.reason: The words may mean that she intended it so, or that Jesus declares what her act means. The text does not say how much she understood.

decisions.choice: "tẩm liệm" (L, B); "chôn cất" (R)
decisions.reason: As in Mark 14:8 and John 12:7: "tẩm liệm" is preparing a body for burial; Readable uses the everyday word.

decisions.choice: "장사 지내다" (L); "장례를 준비하다" (B); "묻힐 때를 위하여 준비하다" (R)
decisions.reason: Bodies were anointed with oil and spices for burial (meaning decision); each level says it in its own register, as the Korean Mark 14:8 does.

source.text: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ὅπου ἐὰν κηρυχθῇ τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τοῦτο ἐν ὅλῳ τῷ κόσμῳ, λαληθήσεται καὶ ὃ ἐποίησεν αὕτη εἰς μνημόσυνον αὐτῆς.

records.literal_gloss: Truly I say to you, wherever is proclaimed the gospel this in whole the world, will be spoken also what did this [woman] for a memorial of her.

en.L: Truly I tell you, wherever this gospel is proclaimed in the whole world, what this [woman] has done will also be spoken of in memory of her."
en.B: Truly I tell you, in every place in the whole world where this gospel is proclaimed, people will also tell what she has done, so that she is remembered."
en.R: I tell you the truth. This good news will be told all over the world. And wherever it is told, people will also tell what this woman did. They will remember her."

es.L: En verdad {{plural_you:les|os}} digo que, dondequiera que se proclame este evangelio en todo el mundo, también se hablará de lo que ella ha hecho, en memoria de ella».
es.B: En verdad {{plural_you:les|os}} digo que en cualquier lugar del mundo entero donde se proclame este evangelio, también se contará lo que ella ha hecho, para que sea recordada».
es.R: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} digo la verdad: esta buena noticia se anunciará por todo el mundo. Y en cualquier lugar donde se anuncie, la gente contará también lo que hizo esta mujer. Así la recordarán».

fr.L: En vérité, je vous le dis : partout où cet Évangile sera proclamé, dans le monde entier, on parlera aussi de ce qu’elle a fait, en mémoire d’elle. »
fr.B: En vérité, je vous le dis, partout dans le monde entier où cet Évangile sera proclamé, on racontera aussi ce qu’elle a fait, et on se souviendra d’elle. »
fr.R: Je vous le dis, c’est la vérité : cette bonne nouvelle sera annoncée dans le monde entier. Et partout où on l’annoncera, on racontera aussi ce que cette femme a fait. On se souviendra d’elle. »

sw.L: Kweli nawaambia, popote Injili hii itakapohubiriwa katika ulimwengu wote, lile alilofanya huyu [mwanamke] litasimuliwa pia kwa ukumbusho wake."
sw.B: Kweli nawaambia, mahali popote katika ulimwengu mzima ambapo Injili hii itatangazwa, watu watasimulia pia jambo alilofanya, ili akumbukwe."
sw.R: Nawaambia ukweli: habari njema hii itahubiriwa duniani kote. Na kila mahali itakapohubiriwa, watu watasimulia pia jambo alilofanya mwanamke huyu. Watamkumbuka."

vi.L: Thật vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các con, bất cứ nơi nào Tin Lành này được rao giảng trong khắp thế gian, điều cô này đã làm cũng sẽ được kể lại để ghi nhớ cô."
vi.B: Thật vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các con, bất cứ nơi nào trong khắp thế gian mà Tin Lành này được rao giảng, người ta cũng sẽ kể lại việc cô đã làm để nhớ đến cô."
vi.R: Ta nói thật với các con: Tin Lành này sẽ được rao giảng khắp nơi trên thế giới. Và ở bất cứ nơi nào Tin Lành được rao giảng, người ta sẽ kể lại việc người phụ nữ này đã làm, và họ sẽ nhớ đến cô."

ko.L: 진실로 너희에게 말한다. 온 세상 어디서든지 이 복음이 선포되는 곳에서는, 이 여자가 한 일도 이야기되어 그 여자를 기억하게 될 것이다."
ko.B: 진실로 너희에게 말한다. 온 세상 어디서든지 이 복음이 전파되는 곳마다, 사람들이 이 여자가 한 일도 이야기하며 그 여자를 기억할 것이다."
ko.R: 내가 분명히 말한다. 이 기쁜 소식이 온 세상에 전해질 것이다. 그 소식이 전해지는 곳마다, 사람들은 이 여자가 한 일도 이야기하고 이 여자를 기억할 것이다."

pt.L: Em verdade eu lhes digo: onde quer que este evangelho for proclamado no mundo inteiro, também o que esta [mulher] fez será contado em memória dela."
pt.B: Em verdade eu lhes digo: em qualquer lugar do mundo inteiro onde este evangelho for proclamado, também se contará o que ela fez, para que ela seja lembrada."
pt.R: Eu garanto a vocês: estas boas-novas vão ser anunciadas no mundo inteiro. E, onde quer que elas forem anunciadas, as pessoas também vão contar o que esta mulher fez. Elas vão se lembrar dela."

decisions.choice: this gospel: the good news of the kingdom, now including Jesus's death
decisions.reason: "Gospel" means good news (4:23; 24:14). "This" ties it to the death for which she has anointed him.

decisions.choice: the whole world: all nations and peoples
decisions.reason: As in 24:14 and 28:19, the good news is to go to every nation.

decisions.choice: in memory of her: so that she will be remembered
decisions.reason: The word can mean a reminder before God (Acts 10:4). Here the telling of her act keeps her memory alive among people.

decisions.choice: told
decisions.reason: Readable uses a simpler word for public announcing.

decisions.choice: En verdad les digo (L, B), Les digo la verdad (R); el evangelio (L, B), la buena noticia (R)
decisions.reason: The renderings of the single "amen" and of "gospel" used throughout Matthew, recorded once in this passage.

decisions.choice: En vérité, je vous le dis (L, B), Je vous le dis, c’est la vérité (R); l’Évangile (L, B), la bonne nouvelle (R)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's forms, as in Mark 14:9, used the same way through the chapter (26:21, 26:29, 26:34). Literal says "on parlera aussi" for the passive "will be spoken of", which French says more naturally with "on".

decisions.choice: Kweli nawaambia (L, B), Nawaambia ukweli (R); Injili (L, B), habari njema (R)
decisions.reason: The renderings of the single "amen" and of "gospel" used throughout Matthew, recorded once in this passage.

decisions.choice: "Thật vậy, Ta nói với các con" (L, B); "Ta nói thật với các con" (R); "Tin Lành" at every level
decisions.reason: The Gospels' form for "Truly I tell you", recorded once for this passage; "Tin Lành" stays at Readable, as in Mark 14:9.

decisions.choice: "진실로 너희에게 말한다" (L, B), "내가 분명히 말한다" (R); "복음" (L, B), "기쁜 소식" (R)
decisions.reason: The settled formula and key term, worded as in the Korean Mark 14:9, the parallel saying.

decisions.choice: Em verdade eu lhes digo (L, B); Eu garanto a vocês (R)
decisions.reason: The settled wording for Jesus' solemn opening (style §6), recorded once for this passage.

source.text: Τότε πορευθεὶς εἷς τῶν δώδεκα, ὁ λεγόμενος Ἰούδας Ἰσκαριώτης, πρὸς τοὺς ἀρχιερεῖς εἶπεν· Τί θέλετέ μοι δοῦναι κἀγὼ ὑμῖν παραδώσω αὐτόν;

records.literal_gloss: Then having gone one of the twelve, the one called Judas Iscariot, to the chief priests \v 15 said, What are you willing to me to give, and I to you will hand over him?

en.L: Then one of the Twelve, the [one] called Judas Iscariot, went to the chief priests \v 15 [and] said, "What are you willing to give me? And I will hand {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} over to you."
en.B: Then one of the Twelve, the man called Judas Iscariot, went to the chief priests \v 15 and asked, "How much will you pay me to hand {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} over to you?"
en.R: Then Judas Iscariot, one of the twelve followers, went to the leading priests. \v 15 He asked them, "What will you pay me if I hand {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} over to you?"

es.L: Entonces, yendo uno de los Doce, el llamado Judas Iscariote, a los principales sacerdotes, \v 15 [les] dijo: «¿Qué me {{plural_you:quieren|queréis}} dar? Y yo {{plural_you:se|os}} {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} entregaré».
es.B: Entonces uno de los Doce, el llamado Judas Iscariote, fue a los jefes de los sacerdotes \v 15 y les preguntó: «¿Cuánto me {{plural_you:pagarán|pagaréis}} si {{plural_you:se|os}} {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} entrego?».
es.R: Entonces Judas Iscariote, uno de los doce seguidores, fue a ver a los jefes de los sacerdotes. \v 15 Les preguntó: «¿Qué me {{plural_you:darán|daréis}} si {{plural_you:se|os}} {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} entrego?».

fr.L: Alors l’un des Douze, celui qu’on appelait Judas Iscariot, s’en alla vers les chefs des prêtres \v 15 [et] dit : « Que voulez-vous me donner ? Et moi, je vous {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} livrerai. »
fr.B: Alors l’un des Douze, celui qu’on appelait Judas Iscariot, alla trouver les chefs des prêtres \v 15 et leur demanda : « Combien me donnerez-vous pour que je vous {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} livre ? »
fr.R: Alors Judas Iscariot, l’un des douze disciples, est allé voir les chefs des prêtres. \v 15 Il leur a demandé : « Combien allez-vous me payer si je vous {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} livre ? »

sw.L: Kisha mmoja wa wale Kumi na Wawili, yule aitwaye Yuda Iskariote, akaenda kwa wakuu wa makuhani, \v 15 akasema, "Mko tayari kunipa nini? Nami nitamtoa kwenu."
sw.B: Kisha mmoja wa wale Kumi na Wawili, mtu aitwaye Yuda Iskariote, aliwaendea wakuu wa makuhani, \v 15 akawauliza, "Mtanilipa kiasi gani nikimkabidhi kwenu?"
sw.R: Kisha Yuda Iskariote, mmoja wa wanafunzi kumi na wawili, aliwaendea wakuu wa makuhani. \v 15 Akawauliza, "Mtanilipa nini nikimkabidhi kwenu?"

vi.L: Bấy giờ một người trong [nhóm] Mười Hai, là người gọi là Giu-đa Ích-ca-ri-ốt, đi đến các thầy tế lễ cả \v 15 [và] nói: "Các ông muốn cho tôi gì? Và tôi sẽ nộp ông ta cho các ông."
vi.B: Bấy giờ một người trong nhóm Mười Hai, tên là Giu-đa Ích-ca-ri-ốt, đi gặp các thầy tế lễ cả \v 15 và hỏi: "Các ông sẽ trả cho tôi bao nhiêu nếu tôi nộp ông ta cho các ông?"
vi.R: Bấy giờ Giu-đa Ích-ca-ri-ốt, một trong mười hai môn đồ, đi gặp các thầy tế lễ cả. \v 15 Ông ta hỏi họ: "Các ông sẽ trả cho tôi bao nhiêu nếu tôi nộp ông ta cho các ông?"

ko.L: 그때에 열둘 가운데 하나인 가룟 유다라고 하는 사람이 대제사장들에게 가서 \v 15 말했다. "당신들은 나에게 무엇을 주려고 합니까? 그러면 내가 그를 당신들에게 넘겨주겠습니다."
ko.B: 그때에 열두 제자 가운데 하나인 가룟 유다라는 사람이 대제사장들을 찾아가서 \v 15 말했다. "내가 예수를 당신들에게 넘겨주면, 나에게 얼마를 주겠습니까?"
ko.R: 그때 예수의 열두 제자 가운데 하나인 가룟 유다가 대제사장들에게 갔다. \v 15 그가 물었다. "내가 예수를 당신들에게 넘겨주면, 나에게 무엇을 주겠습니까?"

pt.L: Então um dos Doze, o chamado Judas Iscariotes, foi aos chefes dos sacerdotes \v 15 [e] disse: "Quanto vocês querem me dar? E eu {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} entregarei a vocês."
pt.B: Então um dos Doze, o homem chamado Judas Iscariotes, foi aos chefes dos sacerdotes \v 15 e perguntou: "Quanto vocês me pagam para eu entregá-{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} a vocês?"
pt.R: Então Judas Iscariotes, um dos doze seguidores de Jesus, foi falar com os chefes dos sacerdotes. \v 15 Ele perguntou: "Quanto vocês vão me pagar se eu entregar Jesus a vocês?"

decisions.choice: then: Judas acts right after the anointing
decisions.reason: Matthew sets Judas's bargain beside the woman's costly gift and Jesus's talk of burial.

decisions.choice: hand him over: betray him to his enemies
alternatives: give him up in a lawful way
decisions.reason: The verb means to hand over. Used of Judas it means betrayal (10:4).

decisions.choice: what will you give me, and I will hand him over: a bargain
decisions.reason: The "and" links the price and the deed: give me something and I will do it.

decisions.choice: How much will you pay me (B); What will you pay me (R)
alternatives: What are you willing to give me
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable state the bargain plainly.

decisions.choice: {{plural_you:se|os}} {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}}
decisions.reason: Two settings meet in "se lo" (to you, him): "se" is the ustedes form of "to you" and "lo" is Jesus. Each word takes its own span, so the two settings can be switched apart.

decisions.choice: "[nhóm] Mười Hai" (L), "nhóm Mười Hai" (B), "mười hai môn đồ" (R); "nộp ... cho các ông"
decisions.reason: As settled for the Gospels and in Mark 14:10: the Twelve as a name, and "nộp" where the people receiving him are named, since "phản bội" cannot take them. Judas speaks to the priests as "tôi" and "các ông" and of Jesus as "ông ta", as opponents do (style guide, section 6), with no deity_pronoun span; he is himself "ông ta" in the narrative.

decisions.choice: "열둘" (L); "열두 제자" (B, R); "넘겨주다" for paradidomi at every level (26:15-16)
decisions.reason: The settled words for the Twelve; Matthew here uses the verb of 26:2, which the English keeps as "hand over" at every level, so Korean keeps "넘겨주다" and the link with 26:2.

decisions.choice: Judas speaks to the chief priests in 합쇼체 with "당신들"; "그를" (L), "예수를" (B, R) with no honorific
decisions.reason: A man bargaining with the authorities speaks politely but as an equal in a deal; he names Jesus plainly, without honour. The English "him" has a deity_pronoun span, which Korean does not carry.

decisions.choice: se eu entregar Jesus a vocês, with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: Readable names Jesus, as the English Readable does in 26:16, because the sentence opens a new scene and a bare "o" after "seguidores de Jesus" is easy to miss.

source.text: οἱ δὲ ἔστησαν αὐτῷ τριάκοντα ἀργύρια.

records.literal_gloss: They and weighed out to him thirty silver pieces.

en.L: And they weighed out to him thirty pieces of silver.
en.B: They paid him thirty silver coins.
en.R: So they paid him thirty silver coins.

es.L: Y ellos le pesaron treinta piezas de plata.
es.B: Ellos le pagaron treinta monedas de plata.
es.R: Entonces ellos le pagaron treinta monedas de plata.

fr.L: Et eux lui pesèrent trente pièces d’argent.
fr.B: Ils lui versèrent trente pièces d’argent.
fr.R: Alors ils lui ont payé trente pièces d’argent.

sw.L: Nao wakampimia sarafu thelathini za fedha.
sw.R: Basi wakamlipa sarafu thelathini za fedha.

vi.L: Họ cân cho ông ta ba mươi miếng bạc.
vi.B: Họ trả cho ông ta ba mươi đồng bạc.
vi.R: Vậy họ trả cho ông ta ba mươi đồng bạc.

ko.L: 그러자 그들은 그에게 은돈 서른 닢을 달아 주었다.
ko.B: 그들은 유다에게 은화 서른 닢을 치러 주었다.
ko.R: 그래서 그들은 유다에게 은돈 서른 닢을 주었다.

pt.L: E eles pesaram para ele trinta [moedas] de prata.
pt.B: Eles lhe pagaram trinta moedas de prata.
pt.R: Então eles pagaram a Judas trinta moedas de prata.

decisions.choice: weighed out: paid him the money
decisions.reason: The verb means to set or to weigh out, and it is the word for weighing wages in Zechariah 11:12. Mark 14:11 says they promised to give him money, and some take Matthew's word in that sense.

decisions.choice: thirty pieces of silver: Zechariah 11:12
decisions.reason: In Zechariah the shepherd's wages are thirty pieces of silver, a sum he calls a fine price, in scorn. Matthew returns to the passage in 27:9-10. Thirty shekels was also the price of a slave (Exodus 21:32).

decisions.choice: thirty pieces of silver: probably silver shekels, worth about four months' wages
decisions.reason: The coin is not named. If they were shekels, each worth about four denarii, the sum was about one hundred twenty days' wages for a laborer.

decisions.choice: thirty silver coins
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name coins. Because the coin is not named, no modern equivalent is given; meaning decision m3 gives the likely value. Literal keeps the familiar wording.

decisions.choice: pesèrent (L), versèrent (B); trente pièces d’argent (every level)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the picture of weighing out the money (m1); Balanced says it was paid. French "pièces d’argent" already says "silver coins" plainly, and it keeps the link with Zechariah 11:12 (m2), so every level uses it.

decisions.choice: sarafu thelathini za fedha (every level)
decisions.reason: The Greek word is "silver [pieces]", most likely silver coins (meaning decision m3). "Sarafu" names a coin plainly; "vipande" (pieces) would leave readers asking pieces of what.

decisions.choice: "cân ... ba mươi miếng bạc" (L); "trả ... ba mươi đồng bạc" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "weighed out" and the pieces of silver, the words of Zechariah 11:12; Balanced and Readable say he was paid in silver coins, as the meaning decision explains.

decisions.choice: "은돈 서른 닢" (L, R); "은화 서른 닢" (B); "달아 주다" (L)
decisions.reason: The phrase of Zechariah 11:12 (meaning decision); Literal keeps "weighed out", the others say "paid". "은 삼십" is the familiar older form; Korean counts coins with "닢". The English has no units span here, so Korean has none.

source.text: καὶ ἀπὸ τότε ἐζήτει εὐκαιρίαν ἵνα αὐτὸν παραδῷ.

records.literal_gloss: And from then he was seeking opportunity that him he might hand over.

en.L: And from then on he was seeking an opportunity to hand {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} over.
en.B: After that, Judas kept looking for the right moment to hand {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} over.
en.R: From then on, Judas waited for a good time to hand Jesus over to them.

es.L: Y desde entonces buscaba una ocasión oportuna para entregarlo.
es.B: Desde entonces, Judas andaba buscando el momento oportuno para entregarlo.
es.R: Desde ese momento, Judas esperaba una buena ocasión para entregarles a Jesús.

fr.L: Et dès lors, il cherchait une occasion favorable pour {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} livrer.
fr.B: À partir de ce moment, Judas cherchait le moment propice pour {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} livrer.
fr.R: À partir de ce moment, Judas a attendu une bonne occasion pour leur livrer Jésus.

sw.L: Na tangu hapo alikuwa akitafuta wakati mwafaka ili amtoe.
sw.B: Tangu wakati huo Yuda alikuwa akivizia nafasi nzuri ya kumkabidhi.
sw.R: Tangu siku hiyo, Yuda alikuwa akisubiri wakati mzuri wa kumkabidhi Yesu kwao.

vi.L: Và từ lúc đó, ông ta tìm dịp thuận tiện để nộp {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Từ đó, Giu-đa tìm dịp thuận tiện để nộp {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Từ lúc ấy, Giu-đa rình chờ đúng lúc để nộp Đức Giê-xu cho họ.

ko.L: 그리고 그때부터 그는 그를 넘겨줄 좋은 기회를 찾고 있었다.
ko.B: 그때부터 유다는 예수를 넘겨줄 알맞은 때를 엿보았다.
ko.R: 그때부터 유다는 예수를 그들에게 넘겨줄 좋은 때를 기다렸다.

pt.L: E desde então ele procurava uma oportunidade para entregá-{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}}.
pt.B: Desde então, Judas ficou procurando o momento certo para entregá-{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}}.
pt.R: A partir daí, Judas ficou esperando uma boa hora para entregar Jesus a eles.

decisions.choice: opportunity: a fitting time, away from the crowds
decisions.reason: The leaders wanted to avoid an uproar (26:5). Judas looks for a time when Jesus is alone with his disciples.

decisions.choice: Judas (B, R); Jesus; to them (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name Judas, and Readable also names Jesus, to make clear who is meant.

decisions.choice: "유다는", "예수를" (B, R); "그들에게" (R)
decisions.reason: Korean names the two men where the Greek has pronouns, as the English Balanced and Readable do.
